entities.name: Colic-migraine association
observations: Infantile colic is associated with maternal migraine and with increased migraine occurrence in childhood; it is not a marker of impaired growth or development. Evidence includes a prospective cohort report, JAMA 2013, DOI:10.1001/jama.2013.3547.

entities.name: PMID:27510256
observations: 2016 Peru study examined chronic respiratory disease, altitude, and depressive symptoms across four settings in adults aged 35 years or older.

entities.name: CRD-altitude depression association
observations: Among 2,953 Peruvian adults in four settings, at least one chronic respiratory disease was associated with higher depressive-symptom category (adjusted OR 1.34, 95% CI 1.06–1.69); altitude residence was also associated (adjusted OR 1.64, 95% CI 1.10–2.43). Major depressive symptoms affected 19%; observational associations do not establish causality.
